messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — sales wants to onboard a log provider called VaultStream for an enterprise POC (Acme). They need it by end of next week. Can we do a quick vendor risk pass?

raj_security: Brief summary pls — what data flows to VaultStream during POC? are we sending PII / customer logs?

maria_sales: They'll ingest application logs + trace IDs. No raw user content by default, but some logs may contain email/user ids in error traces. POC will use a dedicated dataset from Acme with masking requested.

liz_sre: Do they support VPC peering or private endpoints? We can't route prod logs over public endpoints for this customer.

vaultstream_rep: Hi — VaultStream here. We support VPC endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) and IP allowlist. Data at rest encrypted with AES-256; customer-managed keys via AWS KMS are available on enterprise plan. We also provide SOC2 Type II report and completed CAIQ + SIG. Happy to share the docs.

raj_security: Can you attach the CAIQ and SIG? we need to check controls around access management, key mgmt, logging of admin activity, subprocessor list, and retention/deletion policies. Also need evidence of pen test and bug-bounty program.

vaultstream_rep: Upload links: https://vaultstream.example.com/soc2.pdf, https://vaultstream.example.com/caiq.json, subproc: https://vaultstream.example.com/subprocessors.csv. We do annual pentests and have a bug-bounty with HackerOne.

ben_legal: For contract we need subprocessors list with locations, DPA with data deletion clause, and SCCs if data crosses EU. Also need EDR/AV controls and incident notification SLA (72h for breaches).

raj_security: Quick risk flags from my side: 1) Potential PII in logs — require redaction at ingestion or strict retention (7 days for POC). 2) KMS: ensure CMK + key access audit logs. 3) Admin accounts: require MFA + SCIM provisioning + RBAC. 4) Network: require private endpoint for Acme POC.

liz_sre: Also confirm log retention & live tailing controls. We should block live tailing of production traces unless explicitly approved. For POC route, we need a staging-only dataset.

security-triage-bot: Automatic vendor scan: CAIQ score: 82/100, SOC2: yes, vuln management: moderate, active subprocessors: 6 (US, EU).

maria_sales: Sounds doable. Timeline: can VaultStream provide private endpoint + DPA + proof of SOC2 within 3 business days? Acme expects start on Mon.

vaultstream_rep: We can spin up a PrivateLink endpoint in 48 hours for a single AWS account and send the signed DPA template. SOC2 report link is public. We can reduce default retention to 7 days for the POC env.

raj_security: Ok action items: 1) VaultStream to share CAIQ (got it) and SOC2 (link received). 2) Legal to review DPA & SCCs (ben). 3) SRE to validate PrivateLink & ingest redaction config (liz). 4) Security to run quick config checklist and issue risk rating (raj). Target: risk decision by Fri EOD.

ben_legal: I'll review DPA + subprocessors and flag any EU SCC work. If ok, I'll request the DPA signature via DocuSign and include deletion SLA.

liz_sre: I'll validate endpoint and confirm we can set ingestion lambda to scrub emails/IDs. If not, we'll require pre-ingest transform by customer.

raj_security: Provisional risk: MEDIUM — mitigations (private endpoint, CMK, 7-day retention, MFA/SCIM). If any of these are missing, escalate to high.

maria_sales: Great. If everything looks OK we'll proceed with POC signoff. I'll coordinate timelines with Acme and ping here with dates. :thumbsup:

vaultstream_rep: Thanks — will upload the DPA template changes and confirm PrivateLink arn by EOD.

raj_security: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final checklist once legal and SRE confirm.

maria_sales: Closing loop — will update thread when DocuSign sent and when endpoint URL is available.
